summary: Bootstrap apply and dry-run classify existing remote template payload files as plain skipped (identical digest) vs skipped-but-stale (content differs), list stale paths with the capped skipped-path formatter (#1276), and point operators to `gh plate self-migrate --plan` then `gh plate import-payload --strategy conservative` without overwriting remotely (#1257).
migration_impact: No config or behavior change beyond clearer bootstrap output; stale files are still not overwritten on re-run. Operators refresh scaffold via import-payload in a reviewed PR.
agent_notes: Troubleshooting wiki adds PEP 668 / extension-version checks only; no automatic bootstrap overwrite.
